bash -lc 'python - << "PY"
p = "src/p_lx_elf.cpp"
with open(p) as f:
    s = f.read()
marker1 = "e_phoff = get_te64(&ehdri.e_phoff);"
idx1 = s.find(marker1)
assert idx1 != -1, "marker1 not found"
pos1 = s.find("
", idx1) + 1
insert1 = """
    // Validate e_phoff bounds to prevent out-of-bounds reads when parsing PHDRs
    if (e_phoff > file_size) {
        throwCantUnpack("bad e_phoff %p", (void *)e_phoff);
    }
"""
s = s[:pos1] + insert1 + s[pos1:]
marker2 = "e_shoff = get_te64(&ehdri.e_shoff);"
idx2 = s.find(marker2)
assert idx2 != -1, "marker2 not found"
pos2 = s.find("
", idx2) + 1
insert2 = """
    if (e_shoff > file_size) {
        e_phoff = 0;
        e_shoff = 0;
        sz_phdrs = 0;
        return;
    }
"""
s = s[:pos2] + insert2 + s[pos2:]
with open(p, 'w') as f:
    f.write(s)
print("Patched")
PY'
